d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap aaj Ukadiche Modak ki Easy Recipe share kar raha hu, ye bhai steam modak banane me mould bhi nahi chahiega, aur shape bhi easily ban jaega, aap bhi try kariga, Ganesh Chaturthi aa rahi hai, Bappa ke lie jarur se banaiyega.. Jo Coconut-Jaggery wala Saran hota hai na, usme bhi ek special ingredient add karenge :)
Steam / Ukadiche Modak kaise banae :
Ingredients:
For Saran / Stuffing:
Nariyal / Coconut - 1 pc or 1 cup finely grated or scraped
Jaggery - little less than ½ cup
Ghee ½ tbsp
Almonds - 4-5 pcs
